passes.scan: 6 frames, one person (Kuroe) in every frame, Mio absent as the beat says; cart post left, noren top, night street of houses behind, counter bottom; f0-f12 night light, f24-f89 golden burst rays; one bowl, one monocle; no duplicates, ghosts, text or seams.
passes.map: Camera behind the counter (cook's side) at eye level looking across at Kuroe; cart post on the left, noren overhead, street and two-storey houses behind him; the set holds across all six frames.
passes.support: Bowl held in both hands every frame. Monocle: f0-f12 on his right eye, chain to the gold drop pin on his right lapel; f24-f56 flying off up-left on its chain (fine mid-burst); f89 (last frame, ~3.7 s in) the monocle still hangs in the air at shoulder height left of him while its chain sags in a loop BELOW it down past his elbow and back up to the pin: nothing holds it up.
passes.cast: Grey swept-back hair, grey moustache (visible above the bowl in f40), monocle on his RIGHT eye with chain to the right lapel, white shirt, tie, white pocket square: matches the Cast. During and after the burst (f24-f89) the black jacket and waistcoat read mid-grey and the burgundy tie bright red, still in f89; hair spikes up during the burst and settles by f89 (a reaction gag, not counted).
passes.beat: Sips the broth (f0-f12), the taste hits him (eyes go wide, f24), golden burst (f24-f89), monocle flies off on its chain (f24): every verb shown, no negation contradicted.
passes.cross_view: Against the Cast front: same face, hair, moustache, monocle side and chain side; suit colour drifts grey under the burst. No board or plate given.

notes.text: In the last frame (f89) the monocle hovers in mid-air at shoulder height to his right side (screen left) while its chain hangs slack in a loop below it and back up to the lapel pin: an unheld, floating prop; by the end of the take it should have dropped and dangle from the chain below the pin.
notes.where: bottom-right frame (f89), left of his right shoulder/upper arm, screen left of the body
notes.fix: Re-roll or edit the end of the take so the monocle falls and dangles on its chain from the right lapel pin (or is caught in his hand) by f89.

notes.text: Suit colour shift: from f24 to the last frame the black jacket and dark waistcoat render mid-grey and the burgundy tie bright red, and stay that way in f89 after the burst fades.
notes.where: his torso in frames f24-f89 (top-right, bottom row)
notes.fix: Keep the Cast's black suit and burgundy tie under the burst light (darker values, rim light only).

passes.scan: 4 frames, two people (Kuroe, Mio) in each, as the beat says; red lantern top-left, noren top, shutters behind, counter, stockpot on stove right, three stools; no extra people or ghosts. Frames 12.2 and 13.4 show TWO monocles: one worn in an eye and one held in his hand.
passes.map: Camera on the customer side, low eye level: Kuroe on a stool left at the counter, Mio behind the counter centre, pot and burner right, cart post far right, lantern hung top-left; the same set in every frame.
passes.support: Bowl: held by him and taken by Mio (10.2-11.2), then on the counter under her ladle (12.2-13.4): fine. Ladle in Mio's hand. Lantern hangs from out of frame. Hand-held monocle chain runs down to his chest (fine). But in 12.2 and 13.4 a second gold-rimmed monocle sits in his LEFT eye socket while the first is in his left hand, and there are two chains: one from the right lapel drop pin across the waistcoat, one from the held monocle down to his left breast by the pocket square.
passes.cast: Kuroe: grey swept-back hair, moustache, black three-piece suit, burgundy tie, white pocket square match; the worn monocle is on his LEFT eye (Cast: RIGHT) and doubled. Mio: orange-red ponytail, white headband, green apron, black T-shirt: matches.
passes.beat: 'the monocle now in his hand' (C4): it is in his hand in every frame, but in 12.2 and 13.4 he also wears one in his eye, which contradicts 'now in his hand' (it came off in C3). He turns on the stool (back to us in 10.2-11.2, facing camera 12.2-13.4); Mio ladles (12.2-13.4): shown.
passes.cross_view: Against the Cast front: one monocle on the right eye with one chain to the right lapel; the take has two monocles and two chains, the worn one on the other eye. No board or previous-cut frame given for a cut-pair check.

notes.text: Duplicated monocle: in frames 12.2 and 13.4 he holds the monocle up in his left hand AND wears a second gold monocle in his left eye, each with its own chain (one from the right lapel pin across the waistcoat, one from the held monocle down to his left breast). The beat says the monocle is now in his hand; the worn one contradicts it and is also on the wrong eye for the Cast (right eye).
notes.where: bottom-left and bottom-right frames: his face (left eye, screen right of his nose) and raised hand beside it; the two chains across his chest
notes.fix: Edit/re-roll 12.2-13.4 so his eyes are bare and only one monocle exists, in his hand, its single chain running to the right lapel pin.
